newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy inflation trends in line with 1997-98 goals.
newsitem.headline: Italy inflation trends in line with 1997-98 goals.

text.p: The Bank of Italy said on Friday that Italian inflation trends were in line with objectives set for 1997 and 1998.

In a statement following a surprise cut in the discount rate to 6.25 percent to 6.75 percent, the Bank also said Italy was on the road to a gradual return to monetary and exchange stability, but budget and incomes policy must consolidate monetary stability.
